Class AbstractCrudBean<T>

java.lang.Object
br.autorent.sessionbeans.stateless.AbstractCrudBean<T>
Type Parameters:
T - tipo da entidade gerenciada
All Implemented Interfaces:
ICrudService<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
AccessoryBean, AgencyBean, RentalBean, UserBean, VehicleBean
public abstract class AbstractCrudBean<T> extends Object implements ICrudService<T>
Implementação abstrata das operações CRUD genéricas usando JPA. Subclasses concretas herdam as operações.
